test_kind: Independent toy and algebra checks, not project execution or benchmark results

skillnav_batch_assignment.setup: Two distinct toy heads, same features; assignment order mirrors inspected lines647-664 then838.
skillnav_batch_assignment.finding: The inspected call pattern can violate per-item expert routing; actual trained heads and paper runs were not evaluated.

mapnav_adjusted_metric.finding: Even under a relaxed success radius, setting adjusted SPL to1 discards path efficiency.

susa_sigmoid_then_softmax.assumption: Four branch weights are softmax(sigmoid(z)), finite real logits z.
susa_sigmoid_then_softmax.finding: The gate cannot arbitrarily suppress a branch through these weights alone; branch-logit scale remains another degree of freedom.

polarmem_weighted_conflict_example.setup: For a positive query, released mixed-modality score is HAS count minus2*NOT_HAS count.
polarmem_weighted_conflict_example.finding: Weighted scoring can rank a conflicting candidate above a compatible candidate; unlike lexicographic conflict-first ordering.
